issues.description: The problem statement and example usages refer to a static method named acceptSupplyDelivery(String, int, int) on SealSaloon, but the solution defines a static method named receiveDelivery(String, int, int). This name mismatch is structural: tests and the problem specification expect acceptSupplyDelivery, so using receiveDelivery will cause confusion and test failures.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the solution's receiveDelivery method to acceptSupplyDelivery with the same signature (static acceptSupplyDelivery(String name, int price, int quantity)), or add a static acceptSupplyDelivery wrapper that delegates to receiveDelivery. Ensure the method name matches the problem specification and example usages.
